Name: rented-arm64-1
Purpose: The figures of the sprints before the gates, for comparison between sprints only, on a rented ARM64 machine with dedicated cores. A new series: never compared in absolute terms with the figures of the development manifests. No figure under this manifest judges a gate, and the manifest needs no approval (docs/work/epic-1/acceptance.md, rules for every measurement).

Machine.Processor: ARM64, 16 cores, one thread a core

Virtualization: A virtual machine with dedicated cores
Run: One process, built in the Release configuration and started from src without an affinity, on a machine without other work; a master and the children that load from it are instances of the engine in that process, connected over TCP on the loopback interface, except in the scenarios that start a child in a process of its own; the builds of a comparison run round by round with their order rotated, and a figure is judged by the paired ratio inside a round against the spread of two builds of one commit.
